Situation normal.''"
"''What happened?''"
"''Uh, had a slight weapons malfunction. But, uh, everything's perfectly all right now. We're fine. We're all fine here now, thank you. How are you?|Han Solo tries to bluff Toos after the shootout in Detention Block AA-23|audio=Han-Toos-Part1-ANH.flac|{{Film|IV}}}} '''Toos''' was a [[Gender|male]] individual who served as an [[ensign]] aboard the [[Galactic Empire]]'s first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]]. In [[1 BBY]], he was on duty in [[Station Control West]] with [[Sublieutenant]] [[Slallen]] when the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' was brought into the [[Death Star]]'s [[Docking Bay 327]], and the pair argued about the quality of the [[Light freighter|vessel]]. When their [[commanding officer]], [[station commander]] [[Pamel Poul]], demanded they have the [[Hangar|bay]] cleared, Slallen informed her that they could not until the [[scanning crew]] checking the [[freighter]] was finished. Poul then ended her shift and handed over control of the room to [[Commander]] [[Sheard]], but before she could leave, alarms went off, which Slallen and Toos informed both commanders was due to the [[sensor]]s and [[camera]]s having gone down in [[Detention Block AA-23]]. On Poul's orders, Toos tried to get in contact with the [[Prison|detention block]], whose staff had been taken out by the ''Millennium Falcon'' crew members during their mission to [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[prisoner]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. The ''Falcon''{{'s}} [[captain]], [[Han Solo]], responded to Toos's call and tried unsuccessfully to convince him that everything was fine, but Poul ordered Toos to send a [[squad]] into the detention block after Solo [[Blaster|blasted]] the [[comm unit]] in panic. ==Biography== ===Fascination with the ''Falcon''=== {{Quote|Piece of junk? Sublieutenant Slallen, I despair, I really do. That piece of junk, as you call it, is—''"
"''A YT-1300 light freighter, that is currently disrupting the docking bay schedule.''"
"''Yes, ma'am. Sorry, ma'am.''"
"''Don't apologize, Ensign. Just get the docking bay cleared, ''now''.|Toos and Pamel Poul|audio=ToosPoul.flac|}} [[File:Hangarbay327.png|thumb|left|250px|Toos admired the ''Millennium Falcon''.]] Toos was a [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as an [[ensign]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first Death Star]] [[battle station]]. In [[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|IV|1}} As the events of "[[End of Watch]]" happen concurrently with ''A New Hope'', they must also take place in 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. Toos was posted in [[Station Control West]] and was on shift under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[station commander]] [[Pamel Poul]] when the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' was brought aboard by [[tractor beam]]. The [[Light freighter|freighter]] was forced to land in [[Docking Bay 327]], which was under the jurisdiction of Toos's station, resulting in all traffic scheduled for that [[Hangar|bay]] being diverted to [[Docking Bay 328|Docking Bays 328]] and [[Docking Bay 329|329]]. Toos sat at a monitoring station [[Computer|control console]] next to [[Sublieutenant]] [[Slallen]], and the pair argued about the quality of the YT-1300 until Poul approached them to discover why Docking Bay 327 was causing a seven-[[Standard minute|minute]] delay. Slallen explained that her and Toos could not clear the dock, as a [[scanning crew]] under the command of [[Captain]] [[Edmos Khurgee]]''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' was still searching the ''Millennium Falcon''. [[Commander]] [[Sheard]]—Poul's shift replacement—then arrived, and Poul told Toos and Slallen to report to him when Khurgee was finished. Sheard approached and ordered Toos to bring up the ''Falcon'' on the main [[Viewscreen|screen]]. The commanders then spoke with Slallen about her [[Slallen's brother|brother]], a [[Imperial Navy|naval]] [[architect]] whom Toos also knew. ===An alarming situation=== {{Quote|There's an alarm from level five, Detention Block AA-Twenty-Three. Subcontrol reports all sensors in the block have gone down.''"
"''Confirmed. All cams are out.|Slallen and Toos|audio=SlallenToos.flac|}} [[File:DetentionBlockAA23-ANH.png|thumb|right|275px|When rebels attempted to rescue Princess Leia Organa from Detention Block AA-23, Toos and Slallen were alerted.]] An alarm began chirping on Toos's control console, causing him to frown and begin cycling through a series of switches while peering at his [[Computer monitor|monitor]]. When Poul asked what was wrong, Toos began turning a dial to switch through surveillance frequencies but found only screen after screen of static. Slallen then reported that an alarm was going off in [[Detention Block AA-23]] and all [[sensor]]s there were down, to which Toos added that the [[camera]]s in the block were down as well. Unbeknownst to Toos and his colleagues, the crew of the ''Falcon'' had incapacitated the staff of the [[Prison|detention block]] and destroyed the sensors while trying to [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], who was imprisoned there. On Poul's orders, Toos tried to get in contact with the detention block, but as the block held [[Politics|political]] [[prisoner]]s, it had secure [[Comm unit|comms]], so they had to wait for someone to answer. ===A boring conversation=== {{Quote|We're sending a squad up.''"
"''Uh, uh, negative, negative. We have, uh, a reactor leak here, uh, now. Give us a few minutes to lock it down. Uh, large leak, very dangerous.''"
"''Who is this? What's your operating number?''"
"''Uh—|Toos and Han Solo, before the latter ends the conversation by blasting the comm|audio=Han-Toos-Part2-ANH.flac|}} [[File:Hantrooper.png|thumb|left|275px|Han Solo spoke with Toos over the comm.]] When the comm chimed, Toos opened his [[mouth]] to speak but was cut off by [[Han Solo]], captain of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Impersonating an Imperial, Solo tried to persuade Toos that there was nothing going awry in the detention block, claiming that they had simply suffered a [[weapon]]s malfunction. Toos looked to Slallen and on her signal warned Solo that they were sending in a [[squad]]; however, Solo quickly claimed there was a [[reactor]] leak and that, therefore, no one should be sent. Suspicious, Sheard asked to know who was the [[Imperial officer|officer]] on duty in the detention block, and Poul answered that it should be [[Lieutenant]] [[Shann Childsen]].{{InsiderCite|170|Terror Test!}} Toos knew that the voice speaking to him was not that of Childsen and asked for Solo's [[operating number]]. Panicking, Solo ended the conversation by [[Blaster|blasting]] the comm, wryly dismissing their "boring conversation." Poul ordered Toos to perform a systems check, and when he and Slallen reported that there was no reactor leak, Poul ordered the security squad sent in and that [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]][[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] be contacted about the situation. Tarkin had the battle [[Space station|station]] put on full alert, but the crew of the ''Falcon'' managed to escape the [[Death Star]] with Organa. Soon after, the station was destroyed during a [[Battle of Yavin|battle]] with the Rebel Alliance above the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Come on, you're telling me you don't recognize a classic when you see one?|Toos admires the ''Millennium Falcon''|audio=Toos-AClassic.flac|}} Toos considered the YT-1300 line of light [[freighter]]s to be classics and was shocked when he heard Sublieutenant Slallen disparage one, clicking his [[tongue]] in disappointment. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|My number is… 2 4… 6 4. Yes, 2464.''"
"''2464… that's MY operating number!''"
"''You pulling my leg, pal? Are you some kind of spy or… some kind of Rebel infiltrator?|Han Solo and Toos in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''|''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''}} [[File:FACPOV-Christopher.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Toos was first named in the short story "End of Watch."]] Toos first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], as the comm voice speaking to Han Solo during the shootout in Detention Block AA-23. The character was not named in the film, and the accompanying voice actor went uncredited. Toos first received a name in the [[2017]] short story "[[End of Watch]]," written by [[Adam Christopher]] and released as part of the ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]'' anthology book. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Unidentified Imperial (Death Star)|Imperial's]] voice was featured prior to ''A New Hope'' in the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of the film, which was written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]] The ensign was first identified by the operating number "2464" in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', a [[2023]] non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. In the game's version of the events from ''A New Hope'', Toos and Solo have an extended conversation in which Solo makes up the operating number 2464 in response to the ensign's query. Toos objects that 2464 is his operating number, causing Solo to suggest that perhaps Toos is a rebel [[spy]]. Toos then angrily rejects this idea and tells Solo that he is coming to the prison block with a squad himself. If the player does not then progress the level quickly enough, a squad of [[Death Star Trooper|Imperial fleet troopers]] arrives in the cell block, but none of the generic enemy units are specified to be Toos. ==Appearances== *''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' {{Imo}} *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} {{Voice}} *''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' {{Ab|A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy (audiobook)}} {{Voice}} *[[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]] {{Voice}} *''[[Star Wars: A New Hope Cinestory Comic]]'' {{Voice}} *{{StoryCite|story=End of Watch|book=From a Certain Point of View|audiobook=1}} {{1stID|Toos}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' {{Voice}} {{1stID|2464}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Toos}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=トゥース |ka=ტუსი |pl=Toos }} [[Category:Death Star residents]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Officers of the Galactic Empire]]
